ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made as Clinton Street, Brooklyn, New York 11201 (*"Clinton Owner"), and Christopher Browne and Kim Kremer Browne, having an address at 219 Kane Street, Brooklyn, New York 11201 (*"Kane Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Clinton Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, known by the street address 299 Clinton Street, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lot 1 in Block 312 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Clinton Owner Land," said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “Clinton Owner Building,” and the Clinton Owner Land and the Clinton Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Clinton OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS,Kane Owneris the ownerin fee title of certainland,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, known by the street address 217 Kane Street, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lot 56 in Block 312 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Kane Owner Building,”' and the Kane Owner Land and the Kane Owner Building being herein collectively called the“Kane Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Kane Owner is also the current fee owner of 219 Kane Street, designated as Lot 55 in Block 312, Brooklyn, on the Tax Map, which is adjacent to Kane Owner Premises; WHEREAS, the Kane Owner Building is an accessory garage to Clinton Owner Premises and is owned and used by Kane Owner; WHEREAS, there are certain “Floor Area Development Rights"(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Kane Owner Land that are in excess of the “Kane Owner Floor Area Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights"); WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated November 3，2020 and recorded November 23,2020 under CRFN 202000033022 (the ‘Declaration"), the Clinton Owner Premises and the Kane Owner Premises were declared to constitute a single zoning lot (the “Merged Zoning Lot");
